core_research_thesis: Design and development of a stable, efficient, and safe floating car using magnetic levitation and advanced aerodynamic principles
state_of_the_art_prior_art: Magnetic levitation technology in high-speed trains
proven_facts: Magnetic levitation can reduce friction and increase efficiency
Aerodynamic design can reduce air resistance and improve stability
Advanced materials can provide strength and durability while reducing weight
Control systems can ensure stability and safety in various environmental conditions
critical_unanswered_unknowns: Optimal magnetic levitation system design for a floating car
Aerodynamic design parameters for a stable and efficient floating car body
Propulsion system requirements for forward motion and control
Safety and control protocols in emergency situations

proposed_testable_hypotheses.Magnetic Levitation Stability: wind tunnel testing and computational fluid dynamics simulation
proposed_testable_hypotheses.Aerodynamic Efficiency: scale model testing and computational fluid dynamics simulation
proposed_testable_hypotheses.Control System Reliability: simulated scenario testing and hardware-in-the-loop testing

failure_modes_and_risks: Magnetic levitation system failure due to power loss or malfunction
Aerodynamic instability due to turbulence or crosswinds
Propulsion system failure due to mechanical or electrical malfunction
Control system failure due to software or hardware malfunction
required_empirical_data_inputs: Aerodynamic design parameters and testing data
Control system testing and validation data
Materials science data for advanced materials selection and testing
